summary: The Forge Heart is the central core of Discord’s industrial engine, where raw Discord energy is condensed into forge‑power. Muramite engineers and Discord‑forged smiths shape weapons, constructs, and corruption machinery.
history: Discord energy condensed into a stable forge nexus.
Muramite engineers built siphons to extract forge‑power.
War‑Shade armaments were first created here.
The Forge Heart became the industrial center of Discord‑Core.
